test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 17th November 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: C is the brother of B and D is the grandfather of E. B is the daughter-in-law of D and A is the father of E. How is C related to E?
solution:
Preparing the family tree using the following symbols,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4cdd0b30cffaf954e65ff899730e11e9e4ceb2b8a3106f0f1cf7dc6cc2718c84.png] 

Given:

C is the brother of B and D is the grandfather of E. B is the daughter-in-law of D and A is the father of E.

Now breaking the statement,

1) A is the father of E

2) D is the grandfather of E.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0553ff4711448378b66953d00d0dac1e02039c03052a1c08df7da4a3fb8f6705.png] 

3) B is the daughter-in-law of D

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/86578636ef9082a2e4d49587307703234024b0e0d18cd37b86070834b59dfbe0.png] 

4) C is the brother of B 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/695b3193996ab640a9f277b9a7023c6f43b59ba43166cbc0f58f506b8e9101ac.png] 

Thus, C is the "**Maternal uncle**" of the E.

Hence, **"Maternal uncle"** is the correct answer.
